title: E-shop, cart, checkout and vouchers - part 4 of 4 (G-853..G-861; mainly shop_checkout_screen.dart, voucher_screen.dart, shop_provider.dart)

guards.situation: The code is invalid, expired, used up, a gift / Slevomat voucher, or there is no internet; it is refused with the concrete reason.

guards.situation: A second percentage code is added; two percent codes cannot be combined.
guards.customer_sees: Red line 'Nelze kombinovat dva procentni kody'.

guards.situation: Applied codes are listed and can be removed with an X; the discount is recalculated.
guards.customer_sees: Green chips with code and value, red X.
guards.server: yes (server recomputes the discount from the codes it receives)

guards.situation: The card is declined or the payment fails with a known reason; the customer gets a translated error and can retry (the pending marker is cleared).
guards.customer_sees: Error sheet with the reason and 'Zkusit znovu'.
